style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

A spirit can be set to apply ⟦0⟧ when added or removed. This is done, respectively, with ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ effect blocks, looking like the following example:

The effects will only get executed if the idea is added after the game has already started: if done via a history file or a bookmark's ⟦0⟧ block, the effects will not be executed. In that case, it's needed to replicate the effects given when adding the idea within the same effect block that adds the idea.

A spirit can be set to automatically cancel itself once a set of ⟦0⟧ is met. This is done with the ⟦1⟧ block. A cancellation will also trigger the ⟦2⟧ effect block in the idea if one is present. This will look like the following:

Another trigger block that can go into an idea is ⟦0⟧. When starting a civil war, this is evaluated for each side, and the spirit will only appear for sides where this is true. For instance, a ⟦1⟧ will ensure that only the ⟦2⟧ side in a civil war will obtain the spirit. ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ can be preferred over the default, making it appear for both sides.
By default, always false, leading to the spirits disappearing when a civil war starts.
Setting it to be always true

⟦0⟧ is a trigger block that assigns the necessary conditions for the idea to apply its modifiers. If false, the modifiers (including research and equipment bonuses) will not apply, but the idea will not be removed.

Non-spirit ideas can use everything that can be within spirits, however there are more arguments that make sense to be added in them that do not do anything in spirits or don't have any reason to be added.

Hidden idea are exactly the same as regular spirits in every aspect in regards to creation, except for the fact that they have to be defined within the ⟦0⟧ idea category instead of using ⟦1⟧. This will ensure that the idea will be hidden and not show up in the spirit container. However, it can still make sense to create localisation for them: If a hidden idea cancels automatically, the pop-up will show up, and hovering over certain elements (Such as the stability counter or research speed) will show each idea that modifies it.
These arguments are used within the idea category within the ⟦0⟧ file.

⟦0⟧ marks the entire category as designer ideas. This is primarily used for AI. ⟦1⟧ marks the entire category as laws. This is primarily used for AI. ⟦2⟧ marks the entire category to use a list view for selecting the idea, akin to how the base game treats laws.
These will look in the idea file like the following:
This assumes that the idea is of the type that can be selected in-game, such as a law or a designer.

⟦0⟧ is a ⟦1⟧ block that checks only at the game's start or when loading a save, primarily used to restrict an idea to a country (As ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧) and/or a DLC (As ⟦4⟧). If an idea's allowed is unfulfilled, it will never appear within the selection unless it becomes true on the save being reloaded; however, manual assignment via ⟦5⟧ bypasses the check. If left out, assumes to be always allowed. ⟦6⟧
⟦0⟧ is a trigger block that details when exactly you can remove the idea, changing it to a different one in the category. This is checked continuously, unlike ⟦1⟧.

⟦0⟧ is a trigger block that continuously checks every frame if allowed was met, required to make the idea be visible in the decision selection screen. It is preferable to put country or DLC checks into allowed instead.

⟦0⟧ is a trigger block that continuously checks every frame if visible was met, required to be possible to actually take the idea. If false, the idea will remain visible, but will be greyed out and be impossible to take. This is applied on top of the political power cost.
⟦0⟧ is the price in political power it takes to add the idea. This becomes 150 political power if not set⟦1⟧.
⟦0⟧ is the price in political power it takes to remove the idea. If set to -1, the idea cannot be removed manually. Defaults to 0 if not set.

⟦0⟧ is used in ideas to create the escalating price, akin to the recruitment laws. If you have the law with the level of 1, changing to level 3 will require the cost of the idea with the level 2 in addition to the level 3, and vise-versa.
⟦0⟧ is a block of traits that are assigned to this idea, defined in ⟦1⟧, also granting a static modifier and showing up near the idea.

⟦0⟧ decides which intelligence ledger the idea will be assigned to. This is primarily a leftover now applying to the ⟦1⟧ system, but this can still be used in officer corps spirits. Possible values are ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ (Appearing on each of the prior ledgers), ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, and ⟦8⟧.
Idea categories are defined in any ⟦0⟧ file. All categories will be contained in the ⟦1⟧ top element and can contain the following arguments:
⟦0⟧ is a proper idea category slot. This is what shows up in the GUI in the politics view menu, and this is what ideas have to have as their category in their definition.
⟦0⟧ is a ⟦1⟧ slot. Ideas can also be defined to use this slot and it will show up in the GUI like a regular idea slot, however.
⟦0⟧ is the default price in political power to add an idea within one of the slots of this category. This is applied if the idea doesn't have one.
⟦0⟧ is the default price in political power to remove an idea within one of the slots of this category.

⟦0⟧ is the intelligence ledger defined to ideas in this category, unless overridden within the slot, idea, or character. Possible values are ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ (Appearing on each of the prior ledgers), ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧. Additionally, ⟦8⟧ can be used, forcing the ledger to be defined one level lower.
⟦0⟧ is a boolean value making this category not show up in the GUI. Optional, defaults to no.
⟦0⟧ is a boolean value making this category show up in the politics tab. Optional, defaults to yes.

Each idea category represents a row in the country politics view, while each slot represents a slot under that row. The ⟦0⟧ container window within the ⟦1⟧ file decides the user inteface information about each row. The most important thing here is the gridbox, as it decides the following:
The size of each idea slot within the category, by default 80 by width and 64 by height. This is used for distances between slots.
The max amount of slots, ⟦0⟧ If not adjusted, it'd be impossible to have more than 7 idea slots in a category.
The format of the gridbox, deciding in which direction the idea slots are added.

The idea category's icon, shown on the left of the category's row, is decided by the GFX_idea_categories sprite. The sprite is split into multiple frames horizontally, and each category is assigned a part of it depending on its order defined in ⟦0⟧. The sprite is defined in ⟦1⟧ and its definition in the base game consists of the following:
When adding a new category, make sure to update the sprite and the amount of frames accordingly.

An icon can be defined for idea slots, which will be used for them if there is no idea assigned to that slot. This definition in any ⟦0⟧ file, taking XXX_idea_slot as an example, is done the following way:
In other words, the sprite must have the same name as the idea slot but with ⟦0⟧ prepended in the beginning.

The ⟦0⟧ modifier can be used to modify the price in political power for adding ideas or characters in this slot. However, there is a restriction on that modifier. In order for it to work, the idea slot needs to have any ideas or characters defined beforehand.

The files in the ⟦0⟧ folder are loaded in the order of the Unicode character IDs, which put capital letters before underscores, which are put before lowercase letters. For example, this means that a file with the filename of ⟦1⟧ is loaded before ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ (the base game's locations of laws), which would get loaded before ⟦4⟧. Due to the above quirk, this means that an idea with the modifier affecting a price of a law, for instance, ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ unless the laws are stored from files different from base game.
will throw an error if the filename starts with an uppercase character

There are two primary ways to fix this. The first one is to simply change the filename of the country's idea file, changing it from, for instance, ⟦0⟧ to⟦1⟧. In case you have to keep the filename the same to overwrite a file, a new file can be created instead. Alternatively, ⟦2⟧, you could rename the files storing the laws to begin with a character with a smaller ID, for instance, to ⟦3⟧, which would get loaded prior to ⟦4⟧.
assuming that you have a replace_path to the ideas folder

Additionally, this also means that there have to be ideas defined within character slots for the modifier to work, such as ⟦0⟧. This is because characters are loaded later than ideas or country leader traits, so they're not loaded yet when evaluating the modifier, causing the error. This can be bypassed by creating ideas for the character slots in ⟦1⟧ files. These will never appear for the countries as these are character slots rather than idea slots, but an idea that was loaded beforehand will correct the error.
